\u30af\u30cb\u30e5.details: I.e. when rubbing someone with your foot.

\u30af\u30b9\u30c3.details: A sarcastic, slightly twisted laugh; a laugh with wry humor.

\u30b2\u30a8.details: SFX for gasping for air or breath.

\u30b2\u30db\u30b2\u30db.details: SFX for when you are choking/coughing.

\u30b1\u30c3.details: Laugh at someone, especially when you look down on them.

\u30b1\u30fc\u30d6\u30c4.details: SFX for extreme, antagonistic tone or expression.

\u30b1\u30c3\u30b1\u30c3.details: An evil laugh, not quite as strong as *bwahaha*.

\u30b4\u30c3.details: SFX for a burst of sudden power or force

\u30b4\u30fc\u30f3\u30b4\u30fc\u30f3.details: Very loud sound of a bell.

\u30b4\u30a2.details: SFX for the after-effects of a large explosion, such as pillars breaking and stones and rocks crumbling.

\u30b4\u30d0\u30a2.details: SFX for a powerful whirlwind or gust of wind.

\u30b4\u30c1.details: SFX for comedic impact, like when someone gets smacked upside the head (not necessarily in a pain-inducing way).

\u30b4\u30ac\u30a2.details: SFX for the destructive effects after an explosion, like rocks breaking apart
SFX for a powerful force and explosion, like some form of offensive attack

\u30b4\u30b4\u30b4.details: Build up of intense emotion, ex. Jojo no Kimyou na Monogatari; for other menacing sounds, see *gi gi* and *uzo uzo*
The sound of an engine whirring.

\u30b4\u30a4\u30f3.details: SFX for something hitting, i.e. in a fight.

\u30b4\u30ad\u30c3.details: To strike something hard See also *goki-* and *gokin*.

\u30b4\u30ad\u30fc.details: To strike something hard See also *gokin* and *goki*.

\u30b4\u30ad\u30a3\u30a2\u30a2.details: Hitting something or someone really really hard.

\u30b4\u30ad\u30ad\u30ad.details: SFX for strong fire engulfing something.

\u30b4\u30ad\u30f3.details: To strike something hard See also *goki-* and *goki*.

\u30b4\u30c3\u30af\u30ea.details: Like when nodding off to sleep because of exhaustion or having an all-nighter.

\u30b4\u30f3.details: To hit something really hard. Hard enough for the proverbial "gong" sound.

\u30b4\u30f3\u30b4\u30f3.details: A hard poke or grind with the knuckles, esp. on a person's head
SFX for rubbing one's knuckles against something
SFX for running into something and bumping into a subject

\u30b4\u30a9\u30a9\u30fc.details: SFX for a void, black hole, or vortex type space
SFX for a vortex type space, or the sound of a powerful machine, i.e. the roar of an engine or airplane.

\u30b4\u30ed\u30f3\u30b4\u30ed\u30f3.details: Emphasis on sense of laziness, ex. Momo in Kimipe
SFX for something falling and rolling around, such as a boulder rolling.

\u30b4\u30ed\u30ed.details: SFX for rolling around on the ground.

\u30b4\u30b7\u30e3\u30a1\u30c3.details: SFX for a rather dramatic explosion of force, especially in a fighting context.

\u30b4\u30c8\u30f3.details: SfX for a light, semi-muffled clattering sound.

\u30b4\u30c4.details: When you've hit your head on something

\u30b4\u30a6\u30a6.details: Can be a fire sound, often used for Hiei's fire attacks. See also *bo*, *guo-*, and *po*.

\u30b3\u30c3.details: SFX for running or walking footsteps, such as up the stairs or down a hallway.

\u30b3\u30ad\u30b3\u30ad.details: SFX for cracking one's joints or bones, like after a tough workout or in preparation for a fight.

\u30b3\u30c3\u30b3\u30fc.details: SFX for the sound of a rooster or hen call.

\u30b3\u30af.details: To tip one's head in agreement or approval of something

\u30b3\u30f3\u30e2\u30ea.details: When something is piled up high, like fried rice
When you lock yourself up or seclude yourself somehow (whether it'd be in your room or under the blankets).

\u30b3\u30aa.details: SFX for a great presence (can be environmental, indoors, or personified by a humanoid figure etc).

\u30b3\u30dd\u30b3\u30dd.details: SFX for coffee boiling on a coffee maker.

\u30b3\u30dd\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for a short, sharp, explosive sound.

\u30b3\u30dd\u30dd\u30dd.details: SFX for dropping liquid, more splash-like rather than dripping
SFX for liquid during a pouring motion or a falling motion, such as when pouring tea or juice etc.

\u30b3\u30b7\u30e7\u30b3\u30b7\u30e7.details: SFX for tickling, a softer tickle than *kocho kocho*.

\u30b3\u30c8\u30f3.details: SFX for putting something down softly.

\u30b3\u30ef\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for literally crying out "scary!" or "noo!" in an exaggerated manner. Comes from the adjective "scary" or 「こわい」.

\u30b5\u30c3\u30b5\u30c3.details: Light, quick, brushing motion. Like writing with pencil on paper.

\u30b5\u30a1\u30a1.details: Light rain, or rain suddenly starting to fall. See also *zaa* and *sa-*.

\u30b5\u30af.details: SFX for puncturing through a crusty object
SFX for emotional or dramatic effect, such as when a cutting remark is made

\u30b5\u30e9.details: To brush against something soft, usually cloth-like or somewhat elastic material

\u30b5\u30b5\u30c3.details: Like the vicious, fast movement of a sword cutting through something
To move back or retreat in the face of danger or intimidation

\u30b5\u30b5\u30f3.details: Like the vicious, fast movement of a sword cutting through something.

\u30b5\u30b5\u30b5.details: Quick, hasty movement, sometimes to express secretive nature of action.

\u30b5\u30c3\u30b5\u30c8.details: Usually used in a condescending or patronizing tone: Ex: "Hurry up and finish your homework!" Ex: "Go on now!"

\u30b5\u30c3\u30c8.details: To quickly go through something, Ex: skim through the newspaper without going through all the details.

\u30b6\u30a1\u30a1.details: SFX for the hiss of heavy rainfall, stronger sound than *za-*
SFX for a strong gust of wind

\u30b6\u30c3\u30af\u30b6\u30c3\u30af.details: SFX for cutting something, like scissors used to cut hair.

\u30b6\u30af.details: Usually a deep stab, with a knife. See also ブス (Busu). Can also be a mental stab
Sound of a crowd of people, background chatter noise.

\u30b6\u30af\u30b6\u30af.details: Cutting a thick and heavy object. See also *saku saku*
SFX for multiple, deep stabs. Can also be mental stabs, i.e. when cutting remarks are made.

\u30b6\u30f3.details: Like with a knife or sword in an aggressive manner
SFX for suddenly lifting and carrying something heavy, like a muffled grunt

\u30b6\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for hitting the ground in fight, like in a roll or dive move
Like the slash of a sword.

\u30b6\u30c3\u30d1\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for a big splash, notion that there is a big wave after the splash
SFX for a very large body of water making impact, such as a tsunami wave

\u30b6\u30e9\u30c3.details: SFX for a bunch of stuff mixed together that has a lot of texture and/or variety. Ex: Stir-fry veggies where you mix "everything but the kitchen sink".

\u30b6\u30b7\u30e3\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for something sliding, like landing on sand and trying to stop.

\u30b6\u30c3\u30c8.details: To do something fast because they might be impatient or out of time
To give something only a moment of attention, Ex: glance at the newspaper, skim through notes quickly. See also *satto*.

\u30b6\u30ef\u30c3.details: To light up or shine when you see someone.

\u30b6\u30b6\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for calm waves of water.

\u30b6\u30b6\u30b6.details: A "fwishing" kind of sound, can be grassy or liquid-like
SFX for several quick footsteps, like when running away from something or charging towards something. See also *zuzaza* (ズザザ).

\u30b6\u30b6\u30b6\u30c3.details: SFX for a quick motion, such as when one runs or races for something
SFX for a quick and smooth motion, for swiftness

\u30b6\u30c3\u30b6\u30c3.details: Rustling sound of many footsteps trying to be stealthy. See also *zazaza*.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30c3.details: SFX for stepping (or a light impact) on gravel or a similar rough surface.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30c3\u30b8\u30e3\u30c3.details: SFX usually for when you are frying something in the kitchen.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30ab.details: Sound of cocking a gun, a clacking noise.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30ad\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for something sharp, like a pair of scissors
SFX for cutting something using something sharp, like a blade or pair of scissors

\u30b8\u30e3\u30af\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for releasing something, like whipping out a baton or stick and it expands.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30d1\u30f3\u30b8\u30e3\u30.details: Usually with a lot of water and usually when you are actually making the splashing water. Ex. kids in pools.

\u30b8\u30e3\u30ea.details: To make an intimidating appearance, like a bully or yakuza making an appearance and changing the mood completely and suddenly.

\u30b8.details: As in staring at someone, or looking at something for an extended period of time. Comes from the "ji" in "jiro jiro miru" (じろじろ見る).

\u30b8\u30fc\u30fc\u30fc.details: At one point/person for a long time. Unlike ジロジロ (Jiro jiro) it doesn't necessarily mean you are or want to fully examine the thing you are looking at.

\u30b8\u30fc\u30b3\u30b8\u30fc\u30b3.details: SFX for a mechanical wind-up sound, such as a wind-up robot or mechanical figurine.

\u30b8\u30fc\u30c8.details: The sound of staring, silence, or of remaining frozen/motionless.

\u30b8\u30a3\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for gazing fixedly at something or someone.

\u30b8\u30c8\u30fc.details: In the sense that something has caught your attention and you can't take your eyes off it. It can be intentional or unintentional.

\u30b8\u30c3\u30c8.details: This is a short form of the Japanese version of "rude staring" or 「じろじろ見る」

\u30b8\u30c3\u30c8.english: *standing still* *frozen* *stuck wandering in* *trying to bear it*
\u30b8\u30c3\u30c8.details: To be stuck in a phase or condition, Ex: "Even if it's painful, you must bear with it".

\u30b8\u30e7\u30fc.details: SFX for water coming from a hose.

\u30b8\u30e7\u30d0\u30c3.details: SFX for wetting one's pants, losing control of bladder.

\u30b8\u30e7\u30ed\u30fc.details: Can be used for liquid pouring, but not common.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30c3.details: SFX for something slicing the air.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30a1\u30f3.details: SFX for something fragile shattering into a million pieces. Ex: A mirror or glass vase crashing and shattering.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30ab.details: Sound of cocking a gun, a clacking noise.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30ad.details: Something sharp and glittering, like a knife or a pair of scissors.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30c3\u30ad\u30fc\u30f3.details: Something sharp and glittering, like a knife or a pair of scissors. See also *Shaki* (less powerful).

\u30b7\u30e3\u30af\u30b7\u30e3\u30af.details: SFX for the sound of cutting, such as cutting hair with a pair of scissors.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30e9.details: SFX for the movement of clothing or cloth-like material.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30e9\u30f3.details: SFX for a light rattling sound, like when pushing open curtains.

\u30b7\u30e3\u30ea.details: SFX for touching something with a rough texture.

\u30b7\u30c3.details: I.e. poking someone with your toe.

\u30b7\u30d4\u30d4.details: Small splashes of water. See also *pi*.

\u30b7\u30ec.details: When the blame has been placed on him/her, usually because you knew the hidden agenda behind the plot
In a show of indifference, bordering on rudeness.

\u30b7\u30bf\u30c3.details: SFX for being prepared for something, usually used to support comedic relief scenes.

\u30b7\u30ef\u30b7\u30ef.details: SFX for human wrinkles or wrinkles on inanimate objects.

\u30b7\u30e5\u30c3.details: SFX for when fighting, blocking many hits/kicks in one go
SFX for a casual throwing movement.

\u30b7\u30e5\u30fc\u30c3.details: Like the sound of fireworks fizzling, or everlasting birthday candles fizzling

\u30b7\u30e5\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for something hitting "rock bottom" - like a happy meter suddenly falling to zero almost as a comedic effect. Usually used to express emotion.

\u30b7\u30e5\u30eb\u30c3.details: I.e. SFX for when loosening one's tie.

\u30b7\u30e5\u30bf\u30b7\u30e5\u30bf.details: Usually the SFX for ninjas throwing shurikens or people throwing something similar.

\u30b7\u30e5\u30a6.details: SFX for snakes hissing, ex. Kaidoh in PoT (Prince of Tennis) applies to both of these.

\u30b9\u30ac\u30ac\u30ac.details: Combination of vigorous action and menace; loud drastic things happening.

\u30b9\u30b4\u30fc\u30a4.details: Comes from "sugoi" or 「すごい」 which literally translates as "amazing" or "cool." Not technically a SFX, but can be used as one.

\u30b9\u30ab\u30c8.details: Feeling of refreshment, i.e. when you drink a carbonated drink on a hot day. See also *sawa* and *sawayaka*.

\u30b9\u30af\u30c3.details: SFX for changing to an upright position.

\u30b9\u30f3.details: To take a coldhearted attitude; to be curt, blunt or cold
To be concerned inside, while pretending no surface concern
To carry oneself well, in the manner of a geisha.

\u30b9\u30d1\u30b3\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for a powerful, exaggerated hitting motion, like smacking someone smartly with a fan.

\u30b9\u30d1\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for a sudden burst of speed, usually when a character suddenly starts running.

\u30b9\u30d1\u30fc\u30f3.details: Sound of something being slapped, like someone's head being slapped with a slipper or harisen. Ex Sanzo and his harisen in Saiyuki.

\u30b9\u30c3\u30dd\u30f3.details: Sound of something fitting something perfectly, literally it is a "soft shelled turtle."

\u30b9\u30e9.details: SFX for fast action, whether it be movement, speed-reading, etc.

\u30b9\u30eb,\n\u3059\u308b.details: SFX for pulling something off, or for something falling or sliding off.

\u30b9\u30bf\u30bf\u30bf.details: SFX for a series of even but fast steps

\u30b9\u30c8.details: SFX for the light contact of a shoe on a surface.

\u30b9\u30c3\u30c8.details: To do something without a second thought, or to do something out of excitement or over-enthusiasm. Ex: "He quickly stood up and invited the old lady to take his seat"
Ex: "She drank the sake straight down"

\u30b9\u30a6.details: SFX for brushing someone off, physically walking by, or ignoring someone.

\u30b9\u30a5\u30a6\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for a dramatic, slow-motion effect, usually used to emphasize something.

\u30b9\u30b6\u30c3.details: SFX for a squeal or quick breath from shock or surprise.

\u30ba\u30c3.details: SFX for a slow maneuver, usually to emphasize and dramatize something deadly or of high importance/impact about to happen

\u30ba\u30a2\u30c3.details: SFX for a *whoosh* type of intangible effect. Can be thought of as a whirl of momentum (or *sudden momentum*).

\u30ba\u30d3\u30ba\u30d3.details: Sound of a runny nose during a cold.

\u30ba\u30d3\u30d3.details: SFX for sobbing or crying, or tears dropping down one's face as they're crying. See also *zubi zubi*.

\u30ba\u30d3\u30b7\u30c3.details: SFX for a smooth, deadly, vigorous movement. Combination of *zu* and *bishi*.

\u30ba\u30dc\u30c3.details: SFX for jamming something inside of something else, like an arm into a vending machine.

\u30ba\u30c0\u30c0.details: A combination of SFX's for slipping and falling in and around the same time.

\u30ba\u30ac\u30ac\u30ac.details: Combination of vigorous action and menace, loud drastic things happening.

\u30ba\u30b2\u30f3.details: SFX for the revving of an engine as it zips by at high speeds, almost like when it hits the "whining" stage because it's so fast. Higher-pitched than a rumbling sound.

\u30ba\u30b4\u30b4\u30b4.details: Combination of vigorous action and menace, loud drastic things happening.

\u30ba\u30a4\u30c3.details: To look at someone or something intensely
SFX for handing something over to another person, in an almost surprising or sudden manner (like a 'tah-dah' moment)
SFX for roughly handing something over

\u30ba\u30dd\u30c3.details: SFX for someone or something suddenly falling into a hole.

\u30ba\u30eb\u30c3.details: SFX for pulling, pushing, or rubbing something along the surface of the floor

\u30ba\u30b5\u30b5.details: *zu* (vigorous) plus *sasa* *quick motion*; a quick scuttling recoil.

\u30ba\u30b7\u30e3.details: Someone slashing another with a sword, or whip-like motion.

\u30ba\u30c3\u30bf\u30f3.details: Movement for dancing or jamming to the beat of some music.

\u30ba\u30a6\u30f3.details: SFX for a direct hit, usually with a whip-like tool or weapon
SFX for a direct hit, usually with a whip-like tool or weapon
SFX for a direct hit, usually with a whip-like tool or weapon

\u30ba\u30f4\u30a1.details: SFX for getting cut or sliced, and bleeding profusely.

\u30ba\u30e8\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for getting extremely upset or a feeling of doom sets in.

\u30ba\u30b6\u30c3.details: SFX for the squealing of tires
SFX for something struggling for traction, such as when jamming on the brakes of a car

\u30ba\u30b6\u30b6.details: Large movement, like a typhoon or huge storm. See also *zazaza* (ザザザ)

\u30ba\u30be.details: SFX for a sucking or slurping motion, like when slurping noodles very fast
SFX for something slippery that's sliding very fast

\u30ba\u30be\u30fc.details: SFX for when one is falling or tripping.

\u30bc\u30a7\u30fc\u30bc\u30a7\u30fc.details: SFX for being very exhausted, out of breath.

\u30bc\u30d2\u30c3\u30bc\u30cf\u30c3.details: SFX for heavy breathing after running a long time.

\u30bd\u30c3\u30c8.details: To handle something with care. Ex: "He held the wine glass gently in his fingertips"
To make a swift, and unnoticed exit.

\u30bd\u30a6\u30ab.details: Realization of something. Derived from the phrase "I see" or 「そうですか」.

\u30be\u30ea.details: SFX for the friction of something with a rough texture
SFX for the friction of rough texture, like burnt food

\u30be\u30ed\u30c3.details: SFX for a gathering of people, with extra emphasis on large numbers of people being in a rush or hurry to get something.

\u30be\u30ef.details: SFX for a trembling notion, like shivering from fear or shuddering from disgust.

\u30c0\u30c3.details: To charge forward, usually in an aggressive manner; making a run for it.

\u30c0\u30a2\u30c3.details: SFX for running away from something.

\u30c0\u30a2\u30a2\u30f3.details: SFX usually used for fight scenes.

\u30c0\u30c0\u30f3.details: A bunch of people knocking into each other.

\u30c0\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for cutting something with great enthusiasm

\u30c0\u30f3\u30c0\u30f3.details: Like the bouncing of a ball, something rhythmic.

\u30c0\u30e9.details: Continuous sweat dripping, usually when put on the spotlight or super nervous. See also *Dara dara*

\u30bf\u30de\u30bf\u30de.details: Derived from the adverb "occasionally" or 「たまに」.

\u30bf\u30f3\u30c3.details: A lighter form of *thud*. A muffled sound of impact.

\u30bf\u30ce\u30e2\u30fc\u30c3.details: It's a heavily-accented "tanomu" or "頼む". To request; to beg; to ask. To call; to order; to reserve. The humor might be lost in translation. It's like "PUHLEAASSE" but emphasized in a very humble, cute, funny way.

\u30bf\u30e9\u30ea\u30e9\u30ea\u30fc.details: Enjoying sound of music-making, like a violinist playing something.

\u30c1\u30e3\u30c3.details: SFX for a metallic sound, like when sheathing or unsheathing knives or blades.

\u30c1\u30e3\u30f3\u30c8.details: Usually used in a patronizing tone, Ex: "Did you do your homework properly?" Often used in everyday speech.

\u30c1\u30e3\u30e9.details: SFX for a light tinkling, bell-like sound. Can be mechanical, like a "ding" sound from a video game.

\u30c1\u30e3\u30ea\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for sound of coin(s) falling.

\u30c1\u30c3\u30c1\u30c3\u30c1.details: SFX for the chirping of a bird.

\u30c1\u30fc\u30fc\u30f3.details: Sound of a small bell ringing, usually a Buddhist chime before prayers

\u30c1\u30c3\u30af\u30bf\u30c3\u30af.details: Sound of clock, almost in a rhythmic sing-song way.

\u30c1\u30f3\u30c3.details: SFX for a light metallic sound, can be mechanical.

\u30c1\u30f3\u30c1\u30f3.details: Like the sound of a tram passing by. See also *gatan goton*.

\u30c1\u30ea.details: SFX for a sardonic, sarcastic grunt or grin.

\u30c1\u30e7\u30a4\u30c3.details: A white-noise type SFX for something appearing, existing, or a movement.

\u30c1\u30e7\u30b3\u30de\u30ab.details: To move around hastily here and there.

\u30c1\u30e5\u30fc.details: From a straw and the like

\u30c1\u30e5\u30f3.details: SFX for the sound of little birds.

\u30c1\u30e5\u30eb\u30c1\u30e5\u30eb.details: SFX for a light, quieter kind of slurping, almost feminine.

\u30c1\u30e5\u30a6\u30c1\u30e5\u30a6.details: SFX for an animal-like, high-pitched sound.

\u30c2\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for staring, or looking at something/someone for a long period of time.

\u30c4\u30fc\u30f3.details: An awful odor, usually sour-ish that makes you cry. Compare with プーン (Pu-n).

\u30c4\u30fc\u30c4\u30fc\u30c4\u30fc.details: Like when the phone line is busy.

\u30c4\u30ab\u30c4\u30ab\u30c4\u30ab.details: Same notion as *suta suta suta* with an emphasis on being ignorant or prideful.

\u30c7\u30d6\u30fc\u30f3.details: Ex: SFX for a deep breath of exasperation or exhaustion.

\u30c7\u30d6\u30d5\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for a nasal exhaling sound.

\u30c7\u30ec.details: When you become clumsy because you see someone gorgeous.

\u30c7\u30f4\u30fc.details: SFX for something big approaching or hovering or covering something. May be used to emphasize a dramatic effect, such as fear and danger. Ex: A looming figure.

\u30c6\u30b3\u30c6\u30b3.details: SFX for light footsteps, or somewhat hesitant footsteps.

\u30c6\u30f3\u30c6\u30f3\u30c6\u30f3\u30.details: Traditional song to accompany the bouncing of a ball.

\u30c6\u30c6\u30c6.details: Ex. Trying to catch up with someone.

\u30c9\u30a2\u30c3.details: SFX for a sudden burst of speed, usually when a character makes a run for it.

\u30c9\u30a2\u30b7\u30e3\u30a2\u30c3.details: SFX for small explosion or a bunch of things falling all over the place.

\u30d9\u30d9.details: SFX for a mechanical sound, such as the sputtering sound of a scooter motor.

\u30d9\u30c1\u30e3.details: Like sound of licking ice cream sloppily. See also *becha becha*.

\u30d9\u30c1\u30e7\u30fc.details: Licking something wet or sticky. See also *pecho*.

\u30d9\u30a8.details: SFX for the sound of a sheep.

\u30d9\u30b7\u30c3.details: SFX for hitting someone or something with a karate-chop move.

\u30d9\u30c8\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for something elastic, like gum stretching.

\u30d9\u30c4\u30d9\u30c4.details: SFX for separation. Derived from the word "separate" or 「別」as in "different things" or "separate things" 「別の物です」.

\u30da\u30ab\u30fc\u30c3.details: Moment of determination or intuition in a sarcastically or over-done way.

\u30da\u30b7.details: SFX for a loud smacking sound, like slapping someone on the cheek. See also *pashi*.

\u30dc\u30c1\u30dc\u30c1.details: Something happening steadily, as in water dripping.

\u30db\u30a4\u30b5\u30c3\u30c8.details: A little saying like よいしょ、よっこらせ which is said when doing physical tasks that are finished easily.

\u30db\u30b8\u30db\u30b8.details: When you dig into something, mostly used when people dig their nose.

\u30db\u30b1.details: More of a Japanese-ified version of the english "OK", spoken with a somewhat dejected, defeated, or agreeing sigh.

\u30db\u30b3\u30db\u30b3.details: Speaking with mouth full, trying to talk around a mouthful of food.

\u30db\u30c6.details: Like after you've been in the bath or sauna for too long; feeling all and a little too warm.

\u30db\u30ef\u30f3.details: SFX for a warm and soft object. It could be thought of as mixing ほかほか (hokahoka, warm) and ふわふわ (fuwafuwa, soft).

\u30dd\u30a2\u30c3.details: SFX for the end of a transformation.

\u30dd\u30a9\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for the whistling of a machine, such as a train whistle blowing.

\u30dd\u30ea.details: Eating biscuit-type foods, slightly crunchy but doesn't take effort to chew. Note: can also be classified as *poli* instead of *pori*.

\u30dd\u30ed\u30f3\u30dd\u30ed\u30f3.details: SFX for a musical sound from string-like material, such as the twanging of a guitar.

SFX for brushing the ground lightly with one's shoe

\u30dd\u30c8\u30b9.details: SFX for throwing or tossing something in a very direct manner.

\u30dd\u30a6.details: Like with magic or some invisible force.

\u30df\u30a4\u30fc.details: SFX for the meowing of a cat.

A grunt of anger Note: May consider it from the verb for "to be angry" or 「むかつく」

\u30e0\u30d5.details: SFX for light, quiet laughter, as if over an inside joke or a devious plan in the works.

\u30e0\u30d5\u30fc\u30f3.details: SFX for a big breath, big exhale.

\u30e0\u30ab.details: SFX for when someone gets mad/annoyed. Derives from the intransitive verb "to feel irritated or annoyed with something" or 「むかつく」.

\u30e0\u30ad\u30e0\u30ad.details: SFX for an extremely fit body

\u30e0\u30ad\u30fc\u30c3.details: SFX for a growling noise or sound of disappointment, made when one is angry.

\u30e0\u30c3\u30ab.details: SFX for when someone gets mad/annoyed.

\u30e0\u30e0\u30e0.details: SFX for when you are dwelling on something

\u30e0\u30e9.details: SFX for an impulse emotion, a sudden desire to want to do something

\u30e0\u30b7\u30e3.details: Like taking a bit bite off of a drumstick.

\u30e0\u30c3\u30b9\u30ea.details: SFX for a grunt or growling sound of frustration or anger.

\u30e1\u30a8\u30fc\u30e1\u30a8\u30fc.details: SFX for a sheep or goat call.

\u30e1\u30ea.details: When something tears/breaks, usually due to overgrowth like *Meki* but also has a "ripping" notion with it.

\u30e2\u30b3\u30e2\u30b3.details: SFX for soft, light texture, like for a stuffed animal or fluffy clothes.

\u30e2\u30aa\u30fc.details: SFX for the call of a cow.

SFX for the movement of air

\u30e8\u30a4\u30e8\u30a4.details: To lose one's reflexes or strength.

\u30e8\u30b8.details: The sound a cockroach makes when crawling up your back. May be related to *jiri jiri*, which is "inching."
